verdict.rationale: Airbyte provides multiple headless/CI automation paths: a full REST API with token auth for programmatic control (usable with orchestrators like Airflow), an official Terraform provider for config-as-code, abctl/Docker/Kubernetes deployment for non-interactive environments, cron-based sync scheduling, and PyAirbyte for Python-based pipeline automation. This directly supports running Airbyte headlessly in CI/automation pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of CI pipeline usage (e.g., a CI job invoking the API or Terraform provider) rather than just docs claims.
